label: L-30
title: Legacy V1 -> V2 mint route still live on mainnet (V1 NFTMinter unpaused, deployed NFTMigrator 0x22c0fc1a still an authorized NFTMinterV2 minter): fresh V2 claim NFTs can be minted at stale V1 prices (about $3.6) that bypass V2 dispatchers; already usable as StableYieldAccumulator claim gates, and NFTBonfire becomes a second consumer once wired
severityNote: Non-obvious deployment-state footgun (owner removed NFTMigrator from mainnet-addresses.ts in phStaging2 story-059 and would not expect it to mint bonfire tickets). Does not raise total emission and the idle V2 inventory already undercuts it as a burn source; diverts mint revenue from V2 dispatchers and lowers the NFT cost floor from about $10 to about $3.6.
description: Deployment state: NFTMinterV2.authorizedMinters[NFTMigrator] == true and V1 NFTMinter unpaused with dispatchers 1/2/3/5/6 enabled. NFTMinterV2.mintFor (L206-215) takes no payment and does not update price. The route predates story-053: on mainnet (block 26280769) the live StableYieldAccumulator 0x0cD353bf reads nftMinter() == NFTMinterV2 0x39Af0884 and is an authorised burner, so stale-price V2 tickets were already usable as SYA claim gates. story-053 adds NFTBonfire as a second consumer.
impact: Misrouted revenue, not extractable value: mint revenue diverted from Uniboost/UniPoolerV2 to V1 dispatchers and V2 price growth bypassed; cheaper cost-gate tickets for SYA claims today and NFTBonfire burns once wired. Bounded and small.
attackPath: 1. Mint V1 idx2 for about 1.08 SCX (about $3.68), or idx1 for about 288 EYE (about $3.56).
2. NFTMigrator(0x22c0fc1a).migrate() -> NFTMinterV2.mintFor yields a V2 NFT of the same index (fork run at block 26280445, recorded as narrative only; no saved artifact).
3. Use it as an SYA claim gate today, or burn it at NFTBonfire for the pot once wired. Price escalates 10% per mint per index.
attackVector: Mint V1 idx2 for 1.0786 SCX (about $3.68) or idx1 for 288.28 EYE (about $3.56); NFTMigrator.migrate() yields a V2 NFT of the same index (fork: V2 balanceOf(user,5)==1, V1 idx5 price 17,624 -> 19,738 sats); burn at NFTBonfire for the pot. Cost escalates 10% per mint per index.
likelihood: low: profitable only if the pot is above about $3.6 and the attacker beats the holders of about 772 idle V2 NFTs. Never profitable with maxPayout below about 4 AM.
assumptions: The V1 minter stays unpaused and the migrator stays authorized. SYA is an existing consumer; NFTBonfire becomes a second one when wired.
externalRequirements: Live deployment state, verified by on-chain reads at blocks 26280753 and 26280769 (authorizedMinters(0x22c0fc1a) == true; V1 0xd936461f unpaused; SYA nftMinter() == V2 and authorizedBurners(SYA) == true).
assetImpact: Protocol revenue goes to the wrong place, and bonfire burn tickets get cheaper. It is not a value leak out of the protocol. The payer still pays real assets to protocol-owned V1 dispatchers, so the payment moves to the wrong destination and is not stolen or lost. Bonfire emission is time-bounded and does not depend on ticket cost, so the protocol cannot be made to pay out more AM. The actual effects: (1) mint revenue that should reach the V2 dispatchers (Uniboost/UniPoolerV2) goes to the V1 dispatchers, and the gap is the difference in amount and destination between a V1 mint at about $3.6 and a V2 mint at about $10; (2) V2 price growth is bypassed; (3) an unmonitored mint path into a token that is now value-bearing.
recommendation: NFTMinterV2.setAuthorizedMinter(0x22c0fc1aae66873abd029448eaf15a2fd7eed140, false) and/or pause V1 NFTMinter 0xd936461f, ideally in the same phStaging2 story that wires NFTBonfire; then confirm no other authorizedMinters exist. Fix-verification prerequisite: save a fork reproduction (cast trace or forge fork test in work/) of V1 mint -> migrate -> V2 NFT before verifying the fix.
evidence: fork simulation at block 26280445 (V1.mint status 1, migrate status 1) - narrative only, no saved artifact; save a cast trace or forge fork test before fix verification
historical NFTMigrator source: git show df4d590 (src/V2/NFTMigrator.sol no longer exists at c5ad56d)

live on-chain reads at block 26280769: NFTMinterV2.authorizedMinters(0x22c0fc1a) == true; StableYieldAccumulator(0x0cD353bf).nftMinter() == 0x39Af0884; NFTMinterV2.authorizedBurners(SYA) == true (severity-audit.json); V1 NFTMinter(0xd936461f).paused() == false at 26280753 (validity-review.json)
severityJustification: This is a non-obvious deployment-state footgun (Law 3). The owner retired NFTMigrator from mainnet-addresses.ts in phStaging2 story-059, and would be surprised that a retired migrator now mints redeemable bonfire tickets. The authorization was already value-bearing before story-053, because the live StableYieldAccumulator uses NFTMinterV2 as its claim gate; story-053 adds NFTBonfire as a second consumer. Low, not Medium: no emission beyond budget, no user loss, and the redirected revenue is small and bounded by escalating V1 prices. Scope: it belongs in the ycn ledger. The in-scope ycn change (NFTBonfire making every NFTMinterV2 token redeemable) adds a second consumer, and the authorization being exploited is NFTMinterV2.authorizedMinters, a ycn contract's state. Under Law 1 a finding is not dropped because its fix sits in another repo. The fix (setAuthorizedMinter(0x22c0..., false) and/or pause V1 0xd936461f, then confirm there are no other authorized minters) is routed to the phStaging2 NFTBonfire deploy story. Same handling as L-27: a later ycn rescan that still sees it is not an incomplete fix until the phStaging2 story lands.
routing: ledger L (ycn), fix routed to phStaging2.
sanitizerSeverityNote: Non-obvious deployment-state footgun (owner removed NFTMigrator from mainnet-addresses.ts in phStaging2 story-059 and would not expect it to mint bonfire tickets). fixLocus: Fix lives in phStaging2 deployment state, not in yield-claim-nft source: NFTMinterV2.setAuthorizedMinter(0x22c0fc1aae66873abd029448eaf15a2fd7eed140, false) (revoke deployed NFTMigrator authorization) and/or pause V1 NFTMinter 0xd936461f, then confirm no other authorizedMinters. Routed to the (missing) phStaging2 NFTBonfire deploy story. NFTMinterV2.sol code will not change with the fix, so a later yield-claim-nft rescan that still sees this finding is NOT an incomplete fix; verify on chain / via the phStaging2 script audit (same handling as L-27).
